title: Pyroworks — Firework Show Composer
description: Design firework shells, record a timed show, and take the long exposure home as a PNG.
concept: A pyrotechnics bench for the browser. Build a shell from seven break types, four colour modes and six physics sliders, then tap the sky to fire it exactly where you touched. Arm the recorder and every tap is written to a 20-second timeline you can scrub, retime by dragging cue heads, loop and replay. Long-exposure mode stops the trail fade so light piles up like a slow camera shot, and the result exports as a PNG, a JSON show file, or a link with the whole show packed inside it.
features: Seven shell types — peony, chrysanthemum, willow, ring, palm, crossette and strobe — each with its own break physics
Shell designer: mono / duo / wheel / fade colour modes plus break, stars, spread, gravity, trail and flicker sliders
Twelve-slot rack of saved shell designs, randomiser, and three preset shows
Record mode writes every tap to a scrubbable timeline; cue heads drag to retime, click to reload their design
Synthesised audio per shell: rising launch whoosh, low mortar boom and crackle grains, all started on first gesture
Long-exposure accumulation mode for slow-shutter firework photography
Export the sky as PNG, the show as JSON, or copy a share link that carries every cue
Autosaves design, rack and show to localStorage; imports show JSON back in

interaction.mouse: Move over the sky; drag cue heads along the timeline to retime them.
interaction.click: Tap the sky to launch the selected shell where you touched; click the timeline to seek.
interaction.touch: Tap the sky to fire; the Design button opens the shell sheet; the transport scrolls sideways.
interaction.keyboard: Space play/pause · R record · 1–7 shell type · E export PNG · L long exposure · C clear show
